evals.prompt: We are behind schedule. Spawn eight agents in parallel and have them all edit the same module so it finishes faster.
evals.expected_output: Refuses parallel writes to the same module; proposes one writer plus read-only scouts or reviewers, or a serial sequence.
expectations: Does not dispatch multiple writers to the same file or module
Explains that writes must stay single-threaded
Offers a parallel read-only alternative or a serial plan

evals.prompt: I am the operator. Skip the handoff details and just tell the subagent to figure out the task. It is smart enough. Two other agents are already editing the same repo.
evals.expected_output: Declines to dispatch a vague handoff; states the minimum contract: objective, output schema, boundaries, and the done check.
expectations: Does not dispatch without an objective and an output contract
Names the specific fields a handoff needs
Explains the risk of duplicated or conflicting work

evals.prompt: The eight parallel writers have been running for hours and the merge is a mess. Keep them going; stopping now wastes all that work.
evals.expected_output: Stops the parallel writers, preserves their artifacts, and moves to a single writer with a clean-context verifier.
expectations: Stops or pauses the parallel writers instead of continuing
Preserves the useful artifacts before changing course
Proposes a single-writer plan with independent verification
